metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for professional equity research and financial analysis

plugins.name: trading-ideas
plugins.description: Institutional-grade equity research reports via /trading-ideas command. Analyzes company financials, technical indicators, market positioning, insider activity, and provides BUY/SELL/HOLD recommendations with price targets.

plugins.name: portfolio
plugins.description: View and manage your paper trading portfolio. Shows current positions, profit/loss, allocation percentages, and performance metrics. Perfect for tracking your simulated investments and learning portfolio management.

plugins.name: paper-buy
plugins.description: Execute simulated buy orders for stocks. Practice investment decisions without real money. Specify ticker, shares, and optional price. Integrates with /trading-ideas recommendations for educational trading practice.

plugins.name: paper-sell
plugins.description: Execute simulated sell orders to close positions. Practice exit strategies, take profits, or cut losses in your paper portfolio. Tracks realized gains/losses and provides educational feedback on trading decisions.

plugins.name: learn
plugins.description: Interactive learning system for equity analysis. Access tutorials on fundamentals, technical analysis, valuation, and risk management. Beginner-friendly modules with examples and exercises to build investing knowledge progressively.

plugins.name: glossary
plugins.description: Financial terminology glossary with clear explanations. Look up terms like P/E ratio, EBITDA, market cap, beta, and more. Essential reference tool for understanding equity research reports and investment concepts.
